about_the_game:
Wild Space is a turn-based strategy game where dice rolls determine your luck, but it's up to you how you use it. Use your dices wisely and be the quickest ship in space. Choose your path carefully and upgrade your ship along the way. Outwit your opponents and master the dice to claim victory!

TUNE THE SHIP IN YOUR GARAGE

At the beggining of every new game, you can choose which systems of the ship you want to upgrade!

EMBARK ON A JOURNEY WHERE YOU CHOOSE THE PATH

A branching path will lead you to the final boss. Plan your route wisely in order to take the most advantageous path!

USE THE ROLL OF THE DICES TO DECIDE WHAT TO DO

You can't control the number of the dices, but you can pick and choose what to do with them!

UPGRADE YOUR SHIP

Along the galaxy you'll find special places where luck and strategy combine so you can level up your systems and have certain advantages in combat.
